delete.metaDescription: How to permanently delete your MixAI account and the data stored with it.
delete.title: Delete your MixAI account
delete.intro: You can delete your account at any time, from the app or from this page. Deletion is permanent and cannot be undone.

what.account: Your account, sign-in methods and every active session (TVs, phones, browsers)
what.devices: Paired MMO Servers, device tokens, push notification registrations
what.media: Watch profiles, watch history, ratings, collections, playlists, listening history and library metadata synced to the cloud
what.ai: AI connections and keys, generated audio, projects and saved settings
what.billing: Your Stripe customer record (an active subscription is cancelled)
what.apple: Sign in with Apple: we revoke MixAI's access to your Apple ID

delete.keep: Files on your own computer or MMO Server stay where they are — MixAI never uploads your media library. Invoices we are legally required to keep are retained for the statutory period without being linked to an active account.
delete.timing: Deletion happens immediately. Backups roll over within 30 days.
delete.confirmHint: This is the last step. Your account is deleted as soon as you press the button.
delete.failed: Your account could not be deleted ({error}). Try again or write to us.
delete.doneBody: All data linked to it has been removed. You have been signed out on this browser.

signedOutSteps.app: In the MixAI app: Settings → Account → Delete account.
signedOutSteps.web: On the web: sign in below, then come back to this page.
signedOutSteps.email: Can't sign in any more? Email {email} from the address on your account and we delete it within 30 days.
